description: Draw a path from anchor points with optional direction handles, open or closed, as with the Pen or Pencil tool; it takes the document's default object style unless colours are given. Returns the new item

closed.description: Close the path (default false: an open path)

fillColor.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

name.description: A name for the item (Layers panel)

points.description: The anchor points in order (at least two)

left.description: Incoming direction handle [x, y] (mm); defaults to the anchor (no curve)

right.description: Outgoing direction handle [x, y] (mm); defaults to the anchor (no curve)

type.description: Point type: plain, corner, smooth or symmetrical

strokeColor.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

name: draw_path
title: Draw Path
